title: CIA screening genetic databases for Nordic markers

tellings.quote: "Look, we know that Kit Green at the CIA has some program to access the 23 and me and like whatever ancestry.com databases

plain: The CIA is said to have a program that searches consumer DNA databases for genetic markers the story calls "Nordic." The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as something said to him, in a conversation he links to Lyn Buchanan and to Kit Green, a man he places at the CIA: "we know that Kit Green at the CIA has some program to access the 23 and me and like whatever ancestry.com databases." If true, it would mean an intelligence agency is quietly screening the public's DNA for a particular bloodline.
